features.name: Sample Company Cronis
features.description: A pre-configured sample company with customer, vendor, and item data transactions ready for posting, including historical data to simulate a real company environment.

features.name: Setup Guide
features.description: A guided wizard that helps users through setup steps that are unique to their business when creating a new company.

features.name: Data Migration Guide
features.description: A feature that simplifies importing data such as customers, vendors, and items from other accounting systems and Excel files.

features.name: Teaching Tips Toggle
features.description: A user setting that allows turning off teaching tips for experienced users who no longer need guided assistance.

quotes.text: We provide a sample company named Cronis. We've set it up with everything you need to try things out.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the availability and purpose of the sample company for getting started with Business Central.

quotes.text: You get customer, vendor, and item data transactions ready for posting. You also get historical data so it feels like a real company.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains what sample data is included and why it matters for realistic learning and testing.

quotes.text: The setup guide helps you through the steps that are unique to your business.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the guided setup process available for new companies.

quotes.text: The data migration guide makes it easy to import data such as customers, vendors, and items from other accounting systems.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the data migration capability for importing from existing systems.

quotes.text: You can import your company data from Excel files.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates Excel is a supported import format for company data.

quotes.text: Once you're ready to use Business Central on your own, you can turn off the teaching tips in my settings.
quotes.why_it_matters: Supports the Teaching Tips Toggle feature and key point, which otherwise have no quote.
